findings.mechanism: Only start/end dates are destructured. Profile receives date bounds; local drive filtering reconstructs browser-local whole days and inclusive 23:59:59.999. Precise rolling/custom instants from useRangeState are not consumed.
findings.evidence: useRangeState.ts:301-318 establishes header-owned defaults;656-684 supplies rolling/calendar startInstant/endInstantExclusive/timezone.
findings.fix: Use existing exact instants/timezone and keep header defaults. Establish profile endpoint exclusive-bound semantics before claiming server acceptance; no local picker.
findings.queueDedup: No exact open SpeedProfile correction found in owned-source queue lookup; historical audit mechanism cross-reference is context, not a second counted issue.

findings.mechanism: Drive request sends vehicle only and filters only returned rows locally. Hook documents default 50-row page; selected-window coverage is not established. Existing returned-sample disclaimer is preserved, not mistaken for a complete-coverage claim.
findings.evidence: useDriving.ts:89-104,107-130 already supports server start/end options, cancellation and keyed windows.
findings.fix: Pass both exact window options through the existing hook; distinguish sample-no-match from authoritative no drives. Completeness/pagination requires separate proof, not a raised cap.
findings.queueDedup: No exact open SpeedProfile correction found in owned-source queue lookup; historical audit mechanism cross-reference is context, not a second counted issue.

findings.mechanism: readings/sum(readings) is labeled Time share and the chart accessible name claims time-share. No elapsed-time weights or duration denominator enter the calculation; SpeedBucket provides readings count only.
findings.evidence: types/driving.ts:144-162; historical audit count-population/backend citations are context only, not freshly promoted.
findings.fix: Retain counts/ratios; establish the source count population and use truthful localized count-share language. No invented duration endpoint or assumed regular cadence.
findings.queueDedup: No exact open SpeedProfile correction found in owned-source queue lookup; historical audit mechanism cross-reference is context, not a second counted issue.

findings.mechanism: Per-bucket speed and efficiency rows disappear when no eligible drive matches, including drive initial/failure while profile cards remain populated. This is missing fields, not a hidden whole panel.
findings.fix: Always retain both labels with source-local loading/fatal/retained/unknown/unavailable and drive recovery; never invent zero or erase successful profile content.
findings.queueDedup: No exact open SpeedProfile correction found in owned-source queue lookup; historical audit mechanism cross-reference is context, not a second counted issue.

findings.mechanism: Brief retained only checks isRefreshBlocked, not refreshError/stale. With retained failed-refresh data it receives neither loading/unavailable/retained nor sourceStatus override and chooses Source available. Warnings preserve data but brief status omits stale qualification.
findings.evidence: web\src\features\driving\components\operationalbrief-n-z\DrivingSummaryBrief.tsx:28-34,44-45 uses optional sourceStatus and retained props; api/dataState.ts distinguishes refreshError and fatalError.
findings.fix: Use current brief optional status/retained props for refresh-error/stale-aware source status; keep profile/drive trust separate. No new shared trust API or inferred device-offline claim.
findings.queueDedup: No exact open SpeedProfile correction found in owned-source queue lookup; historical audit mechanism cross-reference is context, not a second counted issue.

findings.mechanism: Loading uses query.isLoading instead of DataState.initial. No retained payload plus paused/disabled initial query has no fatalError and can fall through to no-data/no-scatter empty branches. unavailable=!hasData similarly conflates unresolved and authoritative absence.
findings.evidence: api/dataState.ts deriveDataState no-data branch keeps status initial and isRefreshBlocked; StaleRefreshWarning.tsx:59 intentionally does not render with no retained data.
findings.fix: Use initial/isRefreshBlocked/missing-selection semantics before authoritative empty, with truthful source recovery and all section shells preserved.
findings.queueDedup: No exact open SpeedProfile correction found in owned-source queue lookup; historical audit mechanism cross-reference is context, not a second counted issue.

findings.mechanism: Four raw Wh/km bands (<140 success,140-<200 info,200-<260 warning,>=260 danger) but three legend labels omit the info band.
findings.fix: Get domain-approved complete four-band labels and localized accessible meaning. Preserve raw-SI thresholds independent of units; do not remove points or silently reconcile different card thresholds.
findings.queueDedup: No exact open SpeedProfile correction found in owned-source queue lookup; historical audit mechanism cross-reference is context, not a second counted issue.

findings.mechanism: Scatter coordinates are Math.round-ed after display conversion before chart/table data. Preference-aware fmtNumber cannot recover fractions; physical quantization differs by display unit.
findings.evidence: useNumberFormatting.ts:27-28,35 derives locale/precision from saved preferences.
findings.fix: Preserve unrounded converted chart coordinates; format labels/tooltips/table at presentation boundary. Keep every point and raw SI cache; deliberate gauge rounding is distinct.
findings.queueDedup: No exact open SpeedProfile correction found in owned-source queue lookup; historical audit mechanism cross-reference is context, not a second counted issue.
